vb_textbox.text: You will find that you have a run of high numbers with certain colours but they will switch between, when you get a low number switch to the other colour. You might also have a few rounds with lower numbers regardless of which colour you pick and then you will have a few rounds with higher numbers.Just be sure not to miss rounds so you need to be quick and just pick a colour - dont spend too much time thinking about it - I think you will come out overall with a similar number regardless of colour choice. This is similar feedback as I received so I think this is how the game works.
